EmailTemplate.subject: Direct Customer Return Portal - Welcome Email
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Welcome to Intel Retail Partner Solutions Hub!
The Retail Hub is one of the first steps we are taking to provide you with a greater customer experience when interacting with our tools, enabling you to work with us in a simpler and more efficient way. The Retail Hub provides you with access to your work in one location, through Single Sign-On.
Action Required
This notice is to inform you that you have been registered as a representative of {!Account.Name} by an Intel Representative.
An account has been generated that will allow you to access Intel’s Retail Partner Solutions Hub. Please follow the instructions below to get started.
Please retain this e-mail for future reference.
E-mail Address: {!Contact.Email}
What you need to do
Go to Intel’s Retail Partner Solutions Hub and login with your existing Intel account. If you are unsure of your login details, you will be able to request your email login page.
If you feel you have received this e-mail in error, please contact us here.
Visit this link any time to manage your profile.
Please DO NOT reply to this e-mail message. This is an automated response. To ensure that you continue receiving our e-mails, please add us to your address book.
Intel is committed to protecting your privacy. For more information, please see the Intel Privacy Notice.
